description: Unit test script for uploadDumps2.sh, testing functions related to file timestamps, SHA1 sums, MAC addresses, filename composition, and file size changes.

methods.name: testLastModifiedTimeOfFileResultIsNotEmptyIfFileExists
methods.description: Tests that the last modified time of an existing file is not empty.

methods.name: testLastModifiedTimeOfFileResultIsEmptyIfFileDoesNotExist
methods.description: Tests that the last modified time of a non-existent file is empty.

methods.name: testLastModifiedTimeOfFileResultLengthEquals19
methods.description: Checks that the timestamp length is exactly 19 characters.

methods.name: testSha1LengthEquals40
methods.description: Verifies that the SHA1 checksum length is 40 characters.

methods.name: testSha1HasDefaultValue
methods.description: Ensures that the default SHA1 value is all zeros.

methods.name: testFileSizeIsChanged
methods.description: Tests that the file size changes after running the temp file pump script.

methods.name: testFileSizeIsNotChanged
methods.description: Tests that the file size remains unchanged when touching the file.

methods.name: testMacHasDefaultValue
methods.description: Checks that the default MAC address is all zeros.

methods.name: testMacIsNotNullUsingMockFunction
methods.description: Mocks MAC address retrieval to a valid value and tests non-null.

methods.name: testMacWithSpacesGetsDefaultValue
methods.description: Mocks MAC address with spaces and verifies default value is used.

methods.name: testMacContainsOnlyUpperCaseLetters
methods.description: Ensures MAC address is converted to uppercase.

methods.name: testMacLengthIs12
methods.description: Verifies MAC address length is exactly 12 characters.

methods.name: testSetDefaultTimestamp
methods.description: Checks that default timestamp is set correctly.

methods.name: testComposedFileNameIsNotEmpty
methods.description: Ensures filename composition produces a non-empty result.

methods.name: testComposedFileNameDoesNotMatchExpectedName
methods.description: Checks that the composed filename matches the expected pattern.
